question: Show that Huygens principle leads to Snell's law of refraction.

options.A: Huygens principle gives $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{v_2}{v_1}=\dfrac{n_1}{n_2}$, therefore $n_2\sin i=n_1\sin r$.
options.B: Huygens principle gives $i=r$ for every refraction, so $n_1=n_2$.
options.D: Huygens construction gives $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{v_1}{v_2}$. Since $n=\dfrac{c}{v}$, $\dfrac{v_1}{v_2}=\dfrac{n_2}{n_1}$. Therefore, $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{n_2}{n_1}$, or $n_1\sin i=n_2\sin r$.
